with single_authmethod (scope_id, public_id) as (
  select 
    am.scope_id, 
    am.public_id  
  from 
    auth_password_method am,
    (select 
        scope_id, 
        count(public_id) as cnt 
     from 
        auth_password_method 
     group by scope_id) as singles
    where 
      am.scope_id = singles.scope_id and
      singles.cnt = 1
)
